Locality Guide
for Mira Road East, Mumbai

Share
Locality Overview Video
+
178 More
Mira Road is a suburban locality situated in Thane, Mumbai. The locality is situated in the Wester line of Mumbai railway services. The pin code of the locality is 401107. Dahisar, Bhayandar, Naigon and Borivali are the nearby localities to Mira Road. Mira Road has many good schools and colleges situated within the locality. There are many good hospitals and clinics including a jumbo health care center for covid patients here. The locality doesn’t have any water scarcity issues as there are many over head water tanks in the area to solve this problem. The locality has good cellular connections which are of prime importance during the pandemic as many of the people are working from home and the students are attending their online lectures. The local government and civic authorities managed the covid 19 outbreak very well here. No load sheading issues are present in Mira Road. There are good shopping options in the area ranging from street shopping to shopping malls as well. Mira Road is very well connected to all the major localities of Mumbai through road and through railways. Read More
Mira Road has good railway and road connectivity to all parts of Mumbai
Mira Road railway station is situated within the locality and has good frequency of local trains
There are many new residential and commerical projects that have began in this area
There is metro work that has began which will connect to the exisitng metro from Andheri to Mira road
The Kashi Mira bridge is getting a renovation which will also help to widen the service road
What is good here
  • Mira Road has good public transport in the form of buses and local trains
  • The road infrastructure within the locality is quite good and is very well made
  • The service roads are very well built within the locality
  • Mira Road has one of the best schools in the whole neighbourhood ranging from government schools to IB Schools as well read more
  • Mira road has some good Multi Speciality hospitals and a jumbo covid care center as well read more
  • The Sunday market near the Mira road station is quite famous for its low price commodities read more
  • Mira Road has an active night life with many people on the road
  • There are street lights at every corner and at appropriate distances from each other read more
  • There are 3 police stations situated within the locality
  • Mira Road has many good parks such as Pleaseant Park, Ramdev Park, Vardhaman Fantasy read more
  • The locality is quite clean and the roads are swept by the municipal corporation daily read more
  • Mira Road has comparatively low pollution
  • The residential property price was not much affected in pandemic
  • There are many commerical offices to Thane side and can be easily reached from Mira road read more
  • The Western Express Highway passes through Mira Road
What can be better
  • The local trains are quite heavily crowded during the day time
  • Towards Thane the roads are quite narrow which causes congestions
  • The road coniditon is very poor near the checknaka which causes huge traffic jams
  • There are no vet clinics at a walking distance in Mira Road
  • There is no fish market in this locality and one needs to travel a bit to get the same read more
  • There are no 5 star restaurants in Mira Road
  • At some areas of the locality the shops close down by 10 pm
  • Mira Road is also quite famous for many drug heist especially near Naya Nagar
  • The parks are not swept daily and there are many wrappers of food lying in the sand
  • There is very high air pollution in this region due to close proximity to the National Highway read more
  • There is huge noise pollution in the locality as there is metro work ongoing and many new residential projects have commenced here read more
